run_precompute_enumerate_surface: run the script to enumerate and pickle surface structures for a given bulk crystal index
create_enumerate_surfaces_for_saving: create a function that enumerates all symmetrically distinct surfaces of a bulk crystal structure up to a max Miller index
build_standardize_bulk: build a function that standardizes a bulk unit cell to its conventional standard structure using space group analysis
test_is_structure_invertible: test whether a pymatgen structure is symmetric in the z-direction by checking its space group symmetry operations
refactor_flip_struct: refactor a pymatgen structure by flipping it upside down through 180-degree rotation around the x-axis
